list.name: sensor
list.label: Sensor
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT sensor_id FROM telescope.pcap_ingest_log ORDER BY sensor_id
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT sensor_id FROM telescope.pcap_ingest_log ORDER BY sensor_id

panels.title: Packets
panels.description: All TCP packets sent to the telescope in the selected time

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS packets FROM telescope.packets WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND sensor_id IN (${sensor:singlequote})

panels.title: Connection attempts (SYN)
panels.description: SYN without ACK: what a passive telescope sees

targets.rawSql: SELECT countIf(bitAnd(flags, 18) = 2) AS syns FROM telescope.packets WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND sensor_id IN (${sensor:singlequote})
SELECT uniq(src_ip) AS sources FROM telescope.packets WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND sensor_id IN (${sensor:singlequote})
SELECT uniq(dst_port) AS ports FROM telescope.packets WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND sensor_id IN (${sensor:singlequote})

panels.title: Newest packet
panels.description: The files arrive once per rotation (1 h), so up to 1-2 h is normal

targets.rawSql: SELECT toUnixTimestamp(max(ts_max)) * 1000 AS newest FROM telescope.pcap_ingest_log WHERE status = 'ingested' AND sensor_id IN (${sensor:singlequote}) HAVING count() > 0

SELECT time, sensor_id, packets FROM (SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, sensor_id, count() / $__interval_s AS packets FROM telescope.packets WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND sensor_id IN (${sensor:singlequote}) GROUP BY time, sensor_id ORDER BY sensor_id, time WITH FILL STEP $__interval_s) ORDER BY time

panels.title: Packets per second, by kind
panels.description: SYN: connection attempts. Data: packets with a payload. SYN-ACK: backscatter. The rest without payload: ACK, RST, FIN and other

targets.rawSql: WITH multiIf(bitAnd(flags, 18) = 2, 'syn', bitAnd(flags, 18) = 18, 'synack', bitAnd(flags, 4) = 4, 'rst', payload_len > 0, 'data', bitAnd(flags, 17) = 16, 'ack', 'other') AS kind SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, countIf(kind = 'syn') / $__interval_s AS "SYN", countIf(kind = 'ack') / $__interval_s AS "ACK", countIf(kind = 'data') / $__interval_s AS "Data", countIf(kind = 'rst') / $__interval_s AS "RST", countIf(kind = 'synack') / $__interval_s AS "SYN-ACK", countIf(kind = 'other') / $__interval_s AS "Other" FROM telescope.packets WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND sensor_id IN (${sensor:singlequote}) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time WITH FILL STEP $__interval_s

panels.title: Connection attempts per address and hour, by branch
panels.description: SYN without ACK, divided by the number of addresses in the branch (without the special and the management addresses). Current branch assignment

targets.rawSql: WITH cur AS (SELECT sensor_id, ip, branch FROM mgmt.ip_branches WHERE flag = '' AND sensor_id IN (${sensor:singlequote}) AND (sensor_id, valid_from) IN (SELECT sensor_id, max(valid_from) FROM mgmt.ip_branches GROUP BY sensor_id)) SELECT $__timeInterval(p.ts) AS time, 3600 / $__interval_s * countIf(c.branch = 'passive') / nullIf((SELECT countIf(branch = 'passive') FROM cur), 0) AS "passive", 3600 / $__interval_s * countIf(c.branch = 'r-irregular') / nullIf((SELECT countIf(branch = 'r-irregular') FROM cur), 0) AS "r-irregular", 3600 / $__interval_s * countIf(c.branch = 'r-regular') / nullIf((SELECT countIf(branch = 'r-regular') FROM cur), 0) AS "r-regular" FROM telescope.packets AS p INNER JOIN cur AS c ON p.sensor_id = c.sensor_id AND p.dst_ip = c.ip WHERE $__timeFilter(p.ts) AND bitAnd(p.flags, 18) = 2 GROUP BY time ORDER BY time WITH FILL STEP $__interval_s

panels.title: Other packets per address and hour, by branch
panels.description: Everything but connection attempts (handshake ACK, data, RST ...), divided by the number of addresses in the branch. Grows on the answered branches once the responder runs

targets.rawSql: WITH cur AS (SELECT sensor_id, ip, branch FROM mgmt.ip_branches WHERE flag = '' AND sensor_id IN (${sensor:singlequote}) AND (sensor_id, valid_from) IN (SELECT sensor_id, max(valid_from) FROM mgmt.ip_branches GROUP BY sensor_id)) SELECT $__timeInterval(p.ts) AS time, 3600 / $__interval_s * countIf(c.branch = 'passive') / nullIf((SELECT countIf(branch = 'passive') FROM cur), 0) AS "passive", 3600 / $__interval_s * countIf(c.branch = 'r-irregular') / nullIf((SELECT countIf(branch = 'r-irregular') FROM cur), 0) AS "r-irregular", 3600 / $__interval_s * countIf(c.branch = 'r-regular') / nullIf((SELECT countIf(branch = 'r-regular') FROM cur), 0) AS "r-regular" FROM telescope.packets AS p INNER JOIN cur AS c ON p.sensor_id = c.sensor_id AND p.dst_ip = c.ip WHERE $__timeFilter(p.ts) AND bitAnd(p.flags, 18) != 2 GROUP BY time ORDER BY time WITH FILL STEP $__interval_s

SELECT concat('tcp/', toString(dst_port)) AS port, count() AS packets FROM telescope.packets WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND bitAnd(flags, 18) = 2 AND sensor_id IN (${sensor:singlequote}) GROUP BY dst_port ORDER BY packets DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT if(e.country_name = '', 'unknown', e.country_name) AS country, sum(p.n) AS packets FROM (SELECT src_ip, count() AS n FROM telescope.packets WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND bitAnd(flags, 18) = 2 AND sensor_id IN (${sensor:singlequote}) GROUP BY src_ip) AS p LEFT ANY JOIN telescope.source_enrichment AS e ON p.src_ip = e.ip GROUP BY country ORDER BY packets DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT if(e.asn = 0, 'unknown', concat('AS', toString(e.asn), ' ', e.asn_name)) AS network, sum(p.n) AS packets FROM (SELECT src_ip, count() AS n FROM telescope.packets WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND bitAnd(flags, 18) = 2 AND sensor_id IN (${sensor:singlequote}) GROUP BY src_ip) AS p LEFT ANY JOIN telescope.source_enrichment AS e ON p.src_ip = e.ip GROUP BY network ORDER BY packets DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT toString(p.src_ip) AS source, p.packets AS packets, p.addresses AS "telescope addresses", p.ports AS ports, p.with_payload AS "with payload", e.country_name AS country, if(e.asn = 0, '', concat('AS', toString(e.asn), ' ', e.asn_name)) AS network, p.first_seen AS "first seen", p.last_seen AS "last seen" FROM (SELECT src_ip, count() AS packets, uniq(dst_ip) AS addresses, uniq(dst_port) AS ports, countIf(payload_len > 0) AS with_payload, min(ts) AS first_seen, max(ts) AS last_seen FROM telescope.packets WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) AND sensor_id IN (${sensor:singlequote}) GROUP BY src_ip ORDER BY packets DESC LIMIT 50) AS p LEFT ANY JOIN telescope.source_enrichment AS e ON p.src_ip = e.ip ORDER BY packets DESC
